places.name: Hatta Horses at Wadi Hub
places.description: Guided horse rides from Hatta Wadi Hub along mountain trails, through trees and past the lakes, for beginners and experienced riders. Rides of 30 minutes to 2 hours; the longest passes two lakes. Mornings 6:30–11:00 and afternoons 3:30–6:30. Riders from 5 years, up to 100 kg; book with Hatta Horses.
